title: Droid Personality Traits
description: The whole droid trait registry, public/data/canonical/droid_traits.json: Table 3-11, Droid Personality Traits (Special Modifications printed 83). Ruling release-r6-companions-c0 Q3 (R-R6CC-3; R-Y2-1). Nine positive and nine negative traits by d100 band, and the table's two bands that are not traits (91-95, 96-100: the GM or the player invents one; 96-100 then rolls again). Written by scripts/canonical/crafting_droid_batch.py from OggDude CraftDroidTraits.xml (keys, names) and the page (bands, text authored plain, F-EDS-6). Read by the droid resolver (droidOf) for a crafted droid's `traits` and by trait_add rows.

count.description: The number of `traits`; reconciled by the layer check.

id.description: Stable; what a crafted droid's `traits[].trait_id` stores.

d100.description: The inclusive d100 band, [lo, hi], within the trait's own column.

text.description: What the trait means, in this project's plain voice (not the book's prose).

positive.description: Who invents or chooses the positive trait on this band.

negative.description: Who invents or chooses the negative trait on this band.

reroll.description: The band then rolls again on the table (96-100).
